paras: The AST 5100 Street Series coilovers for the BMW M2 F87 are engineered to deliver a major step up in handling precision, ride control, and driver feedback while remaining well suited to daily driving. Built around motorsport-derived monotube technology, the 5100 Series offers consistent damping performance, improved heat management, and a sharper, more connected feel than typical twin-tube suspension.

The AST 5100 Series uses a high-pressure monotube damper design where the oil and nitrogen are separated by a floating piston. This enables a larger internal piston for improved damping accuracy, better grip, and more consistent performance under hard braking and cornering. High-pressure nitrogen helps prevent cavitation, maintaining stable damping behaviour when the suspension is working hard.
hl: Monotube damper design for consistent performance and improved control
Floating piston design with high-pressure nitrogen to reduce cavitation
44.5mm inverted strut shaft design for strength and rigidity
ft: AST 5100 Street Series Coilovers (No Top Mounts) for BMW M2 (F87 / F87 Competition)
